concerns.text: Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires a “Verified datasets” block listing the canonical URLs used. The plan’s Constitution Check table references this block, but the block itself is missing, violating the constitution.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) states that every figure/table must reference a specific row in `merged_dataset.csv` and a code block. The plan claims compliance but does not explicitly link the generated figures (`fig_time_by_condition.pdf`, `fig_corr_heatmap.png`) to dataset rows or code blocks, leaving the SSoT traceability unclear.
